units.text: INT. JURY DELIBERATION ROOM - DAY
A bare room, a long table, a window onto a brick wall.
Water pitcher, paper cups, a stack of exhibit binders.
COUNSEL OYELARAN, forties, a defense attorney in a charcoal suit, waits with a briefcase beside the table.
CLERK MAVIS, sixty, a stout woman with reading glasses on a chain, sets down a tray of sandwiches.
Counselor, the court says twenty minutes. No more.
units.name: CLERK MAVIS

units.text: Thank you, Mavis.
units.name: OYELARAN

units.text: Judge's orders. The juror wants to ask a question and the judge wants counsel present.
units.name: CLERK MAVIS

units.text: Which juror?
units.name: OYELARAN

units.text: Number seven. He's been quiet all week.
units.name: CLERK MAVIS

units.text: Quiet ones worry me.
units.name: OYELARAN

units.text: A knock.
Mavis crosses, opens it.
A JUROR enters, sixties, in a corduroy blazer, hat in hand.
He hesitates at the head of the table.
May I sit?
units.name: JUROR 7

units.text: Please.
units.name: OYELARAN

units.text: He sits.
Sets his hat on the table.
Smooths the brim.
I don't want to cause trouble.
units.name: JUROR 7

units.text: Then ask your question.
units.name: OYELARAN

units.text: The man on trial. Did he really have no alibi?
units.name: JUROR 7

units.text: That's a matter for the jury, sir.
units.name: OYELARAN

units.text: I know. But I think I saw him that night.
units.name: JUROR 7

units.text: Mavis's pen stops.
Oyelaran sets his briefcase down very slowly.
Saw him where?
units.name: OYELARAN

units.text: At the diner on Fifth. Ten-fifteen. Eating pie.
units.name: JUROR 7

units.text: You're certain?
units.name: OYELARAN

units.text: Blueberry. He argued with the waitress about the whipped cream.
units.name: JUROR 7

units.text: Oyelaran and Mavis exchange a look.
The room is very quiet.
Sir, you can't share outside evidence with the jury.
units.name: CLERK MAVIS

units.text: I haven't. I haven't told a soul.
units.name: JUROR 7

units.text: I need to bring the judge. Please don't speak to anyone.
units.name: OYELARAN

units.text: My name is Delacroix. Henri Delacroix. If it matters.
units.name: JUROR 7

units.text: It matters, Mr. Delacroix.
units.name: OYELARAN

units.text: Delacroix nods, picks up his hat, turns it in his hands.
I thought the truth would be simpler.
units.name: DELACROIX

units.text: It never is.
units.name: OYELARAN

units.text: Mavis opens the door and steps into the corridor.
Oyelaran follows.
Get Judge Hartnell. Now.
units.name: OYELARAN

units.text: Yes, Counselor.
units.name: CLERK MAVIS

units.text: She leaves at a trot.
Oyelaran shuts the door.
Delacroix sits alone at the long table, his hat in his lap.
